Share linked documents

This share link will allow people to view this document and all documents linked from it. Each document below gets its own link with the same permission as the one you chose. Uncheck any document you don’t want to include — links to it will appear as plain text instead.

Add documents to this set

Each document you add joins the set right away. It gets a link with the set’s permission — or reuses its own existing link, if it already has one — and appears in the wiki sidebar when this set is presented as a wiki.

Add linked documents to this set

These documents are linked from documents in this set, but aren’t part of it yet — a reader who follows a link to one of them sees it as plain text. Each document you add gets a link with this set’s permission — or reuses its own existing link, if it already has one — and joins the wiki sidebar when this set is presented as a wiki.

Add existing documents to this set

You just started watching for the “” set. These documents already match — share them as part of the set now? Each one gets a link with the set’s permission — or reuses its own existing link, if it already has one. The watch stays on either way: skipping this only leaves the existing documents out.

Share this document as part of the following bundles?

“” landed in a folder or gained a tag that these share bundles watch. It gets a link with each bundle’s permission and joins that set. Uncheck any bundle you don’t want — the choice is for this time only, and you’ll be asked again next time.
